findings.passage: Since at least 2017 he has said that being himself in public is harder than being someone else.
findings.problem: The 2026 half is direct (Interview: "braver ... to be someone else"; GQ: "easier ... than be me"). But the 2017 MTV source shows him guarding the gap between Connor and himself, which he framed as protecting fans' "illusion." He does not say there that being himself is harder. "He has said" turns a 2017 behaviour, and his reason for it, into a statement he first made explicitly in 2026.
findings.acceptance_test: The sentence separates the two dates, e.g. "Since at least 2017 he has kept a distance between his characters and himself, and in 2026 he said outright that being himself in public is harder." Alternatively it keeps "he has said" only for 2026. C68 matches the new wording.

findings.passage: To Cultured in 2026: "I think, unfortunately, I'm doomed to do this."
findings.problem: In the Cultured Q&A the line comes inside a recollection of deciding to move to New York ("I kind of said, 'I think, unfortunately, I'm doomed to do this.'"). Cultured's own lede presents it as current, so the use is defensible. But "his account of the job won't hold still" reads it as a 2026 stance without the recollection.
findings.acceptance_test: The sentence either signals the recollection (e.g. "To Cultured in 2026, remembering the teenager who left for New York, he said...") or quotes Cultured's present-tense framing ("Unfortunately," he relents, "I'm doomed to do this"). C91 records which.

The meaning is unchanged, but the printed contraction rests on the minority reading, and the evidence says "both local transcriptions agree."
findings.acceptance_test: Someone listens at about 10:40 of 1SyXL1F43Qg and prints what he says, or the quote prints "because" (two of three transcriptions). C07's note records the variance.

findings.passage: To Cultured, his first answer was, "You know, there really isn't a lot of thought." Pressed, he said it is "very easy to get swept up in noise," which makes it hard to "hear myself think, and feel what is right for me."
findings.problem: This is a pacing and redundancy problem, not a factual one. "Two years out of view" carries about eleven quote fragments in two paragraphs. The same fragments ("noise," "stamina," "hear myself think," "public gaze"/"whoever you wanted to be") are quoted again in the Six and Nine sections, so three sections cycle one small set of quotes. "Of these episodes" then refers to episodes the section never lists. This keeps the writing from rising above a solid 8.
findings.acceptance_test: Each of those fragments is quoted once in the body, and later sections refer back by paraphrase ("the noise he described," "the public gaze"). The gap section keeps every reason category (recalibrate/stamina, public gaze, financing, no thought, noise, overwhelm, control) with no more than about six quoted fragments. "Of these episodes" names them, e.g. "Of the 2018 exit, the 2021 refusals and move home, and the 2024-26 quiet". No source, attribution or date is lost.
